mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes loratadine to its active metabolite descarboethoxyloratadine, potentially increasing loratadine plasma concentrations and QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor for increased antihistamine effects and QT prolongation; consider alternative macrolide or H1-antagonist if possible; baseline ECG may be warranted in susceptible patients.
